name: FilmeeAi API
description: Add AI video editing to your own app. Edit recorded talking-head videos (explainer animation that matches what is said, burned-in subtitles, skin beautify, background music) or generate narrated anime videos from text. Every job is asynchronous: create it, poll GET /videos/{id} (or receive a webhook), then POST /videos/{id}/result to get the file. Credits are consumed only by the first successful result call; failed jobs are free.
